extraction.agency_name: Maryland Lottery and Gaming Control Commission

findings.title: Certain amended minority participation goals for five of the video lottery terminal licensees with related calendar year expenditures were not yet established.
findings.description: Certain amended calendar year 2014 minority participation goals had not been established for five video lottery terminal (VLT) licensees; including four goals for which there were calendar year 2014 expenditures. Each of the six licensees should have three goals established – one each related to architectural/engineering, construction, and operational procurement activities, resulting in a total of 18 goals. As of June 30, 2016, 10 goals had been established, 5 goals were in process, and 3 goals (for which there was no calendar year 2014 financial activity) had not been established.
findings.recommendation: We recommend that MLGCC establish amended minority participation goals for all categories in which VLT licensees have expenditures.
